title: React Native Basics
subtitle: A collection of some basic react native features with practical implementations

item_1.title: Pull to Refresh
item_1.description: The component RefreshControl provides pull-to-refresh functionality for a ScrollView or FlatList component. It can be used to refresh the contents of a list or refresh the contents of a page.

item_2.title: Swipe to Delete
item_2.description: This example demonstrates how to use the Swipeable component to add swipe-to-delete functionality to a FlatList component.

item_3.title: Drag and drop for reordering
item_3.description: This example demonstrates how to use the Reorder component to add drag-and-drop functionality to a FlatList component.

item_4.title: Lista Expansível
item_4.description: This example demonstrates how to use the ExpandableList component to add expandable list functionality to a FlatList component.

item_5.title: Toast Android
item_5.description: This example demonstrates how ToastAndroid works to display quick messages when performing actions in the app.
